To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the harmonic measurement system is a useful tool for characterizing gradient errors of Main Ring quadrupole magnets and that, for the quadrupoles we have measured, the harmonic content is generally low, and that the harmonics which are present are generally well behaved and can be compensated for by the existing correction system.

(1) the quadrupole gradient errors in the Main Ring are well below the design goal of 0.1%, (2) the quadrupoles are not significantly nonlinear, (3) the quadrupolar field errors are not a significant source of chromatic effects in the Main Ring, (4) the quadrupolars are not significantly affected by radiation damage, and (5) the quadrupolers can be used for the Main Injector with little modification

(1) the harmonic measurement system is capable of providing a detailed description of the gradient error spectrum of a quadrupole magnet; (2) the harmonic measurement results are consistent with the results of the field map measurements; (3) the harmonic measurement technique is a valuable tool for characterizing the gradient error spectrum for quadrupole magnets; and (4) the harmonic measurement data for Main Ring quadruples can be used to predict the effect of gradient errors on the Main Ring lattice.<<ET
